# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects any active spell or item from the Channeling realm; caster can
concentrate on a different 5 foot radius each round.
@@ 2
As Detect Channeling, except realm is Essence.
@@ 3
As Detect Channeling, except realm is Mentalism.
@@ 4
As Detect Channeling, except detects living beings.
@@ 5
As Detect Channeling, except detects curses on people or things.
@@ 6
As Detect Channeling, except detects the presence of Undead.
@@ 7
As Detect Channeling, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap
sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance).
@@ 8
As Detect Channeling, except it analyzes one living being; giving race, age,
and current state of health.
@@ 9
As Detect Channeling, except detects invisible things. All attacks against an
invisible target suffer a -50 penalty (instead of the standard -100).
@@ 10
As Detect Channeling, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e.,
level) of the person, item, or spell examined.
@@ 11
As Detect Channeling, except it gives an analysis of any poisons on a single
object or in a single being.
@@ 13
As Detect Channeling, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or cast)
and what spell list it was cast from. In the case of a person, it gives his
exact profession.
@@ 15
As Detect Channeling, except detects any spell that has ever been cast in the
area examined.
@@ 17
As Perceive Power I, except range is 500' and area is 50' radius.
@@ 18
Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the
caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have
the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least
two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight,
etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes
to make the item unique.
@@ 20
As Detect Channeling, except a curse may be analyzed for level, effect and
required cure.
@@ 25
As Life Typing, except also gives exact profession, alignment, and other
pertinent details.
@@ 30
As Detect Channeling, except any of the lower level spells on this list can be
used once per round.
@@ 50
As Location, except range is 1 mile per level.
